user.title: Google Home Setup
user.description:
Google requires authentication to communicate with your Google Home speakers and HomeGraph devices.

### 🔐 Choose an authentication method:
- **Token (Master Token / Web OAuth Token)**: 100% reliable, recommended by Google Home community.
- **Google Home Token Hub Add-on**: Automatic setup via Add-on (auto-detected, edge & stable).
- **App Password**: Automatic token generation (requires App Password from Google Account).

token.title: Token Authentication
token.description:
### 🔑 30-Second Token Guide (Recommended):
1. Open [accounts.google.com/EmbeddedSetup](https://accounts.google.com/EmbeddedSetup) in your browser and log in with your Google account.
2. **Important**: The final page will remain on a loading/blank screen (this is normal and indicates the token was created!).
3. Press **F12** (Developer Tools) -> **Application** (or Storage) -> **Cookies** (https://accounts.google.com).
4. Copy the value of the **oauth_token** cookie (starts with oauth2_4/...).
5. Enter your Google Email and paste the token below.

*(If you already have a Master Token as_et/..., you can also paste it directly below)*.

mode.title: Integration Mode & Device Filtering
mode.description:
### ⚙️ Choose how Google Home should integrate with Home Assistant:
- **Local & Cloud (Hybrid)**: Fast local control for alarms/timers + cloud discovery for all Google Home devices.
- **Local Only**: Pure local network communication for speakers.
- **Cloud Only**: Cloud HomeGraph without local speaker polling.

data.ignore_ha_synced_devices: Ignore devices already synced from Home Assistant (prevents duplicate entities & automation loops)

addon.title: Connect with Google Home Add-on
addon.description: Ensure the **Google Home Token Hub** Add-on is installed and running.

addon_login.title: Add-on Login
addon_login.description: Enter your Google account credentials. The Add-on will perform the login and extract your master token.

addon_action.title: Setup Complete - Add-on Status
addon_action.description:
✅ **Master Token successfully acquired for {email}!**

The Google Home integration runs locally/cloud and does not require the Add-on to keep running.

What would you like to do with the Add-on?

app_password.title: App Password Login
app_password.description:
Enter your Google Account Email and a 16-character [Google App Password](https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords).

The integration will automatically connect to Google and extract your permanent Master Token in the background.

error.invalid_master_token: The token provided is invalid or expired. Please generate a fresh token from https://accounts.google.com/EmbeddedSetup.
error.advanced_protection: Your Google account has the Advanced Protection Program enabled. Google strictly prohibits App Passwords for this account. Please use the Token method instead.
error.two_factor_required: Google rejected password login (BadAuthentication / 2FA). Please enter an App Password at https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords or provide a web OAuth token.
error.missing_email_for_oauth: Please enter your Google Account Email above.
error.missing_credentials: Please enter either a password or a token.
error.addon_not_logged_in: The Google Home Add-on is running, but no token has been entered yet.
error.cannot_connect_addon: Could not connect to Google Home Add-on. Make sure it is installed and running.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid email address or credentials. Please verify your data.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please check Home Assistant logs.
